title: The seven bridges of Königsberg
notes: Four land masses, A to D, and seven bridges. The page has no double edges, so the second bridge to B and to C gets a midpoint, e and f. A, B, C and D all have odd degree: four odd vertices, so no walk crosses every bridge once. Euler, 1736.
ops: A-B, A-e, B-e, A-C, A-f, C-f, A-D, B-D, C-D
